app.title: QuotaVista
app.syntheticBanner: Prototype demo — synthetic data only. No real provider accounts are connected.
common.error: Something went wrong showing this view. The recorded data is untouched.
overview.heading: Overview
overview.scope.heading: Scope {scope}
overview.summary.heading: Recorded tokens in the selected range
overview.summary.provisional: Provisional: the current period is clipped at the refresh time.
overview.metric.staleNote: Source data is older than the last refresh.
statistics.heading: Statistics
statistics.range.provisional: Provisional — the current period is clipped at the data-as-of time and may still change.
statistics.chart.label: Bar chart of recorded tokens per {grain}
statistics.chart.empty: No recorded tokens in this range. Unavailable periods are shown as gaps, never as zero.
statistics.excluded.heading: Excluded scopes
statistics.plans.heading: Per-plan breakdown
statistics.error.queryFailed: Statistics query failed. The previous view is kept.

connections.heading: Connections
connections.list.heading: Demo connections
connections.alias.label: Connection alias
connections.alias.hint: Draft input is not secret and survives language switching.
settings.heading: Settings
settings.language.label: Interface language
settings.language.hint: Choice takes effect immediately; during the prototype it is kept between restarts by a temporary renderer-side store.
settings.reporting.heading: Reporting
settings.reporting.note: Language changes never alter the reporting time zone or currency.
settings.prototype.heading: Prototype limits
settings.prototype.note: Persisted settings and real connections arrive in later prototype tasks.
overview.status.scaffoldMessage: Development scaffold running without provider credentials.
overview.metrics.heading: Demo quota snapshot
overview.metric.note: Values are synthetic examples, not real provider data.
statistics.series.heading: Synthetic daily consumption
statistics.chart.description: Seven synthetic daily totals. The tallest bar is 12,000 tokens; values are demo data.
connections.list.empty: No connections yet. Add one below with synthetic credentials.
connections.add.heading: Add a connection
connections.add.secret.hint: Cleared after every submission and never written to browser storage.
connections.add.storageMode.hint: Session-only credentials are held in memory and need to be provided again after a restart.
connections.add.note: Simulation only: the credential is stored locally and no provider validation occurs.
connections.actions.heading: Actions
connections.rotate.heading: Replace credentials
connections.rotate.note: Same account credentials keep the history; a different or unverified identity is refused instead of being merged silently.
connections.needsCredentials.note: This connection uses session-only storage. Provide the credential again after a restart.
connections.deletionPending.note: Cleanup failed; the connection stays in deletion pending and the removal can be retried, including after a restart.
connections.replaceConnection.hint: A different identity cannot silently take over this connection. Disable it and add a separate connection instead.
connections.operation.heading: Operation status
connections.operation.nextAction.unlockS: Unlock the device credential store and retry.
connections.operation.nextAction.replace: A different identity cannot be merged here.
connections.error.heading: The last action failed
connections.error.validation: Check the entered values: an alias must be 1–80 characters and a credential non-empty without line breaks.
connections.error.needsCredentials: This connection needs credentials before it can be used.
connections.error.secretStoreLocked: The device credential store is locked.
connections.error.storageError: Local storage failed; recorded data is untouched.
connections.error.unsupported: This action is not available in the prototype phase.
settings.reporting.zone.hint: An IANA zone name such as UTC or Asia/Shanghai; independent of the interface language.
settings.polling.heading: Refresh interval
settings.polling.label: Automatic refresh
settings.polling.note: The interval is stored with the persisted settings; scheduling it runs in a later prototype task.
settings.thresholds.heading: Thresholds
settings.thresholds.quota.hint: A fraction of remaining quota between 0 and 1, e.g. 0.2.
settings.thresholds.balance.hint: An amount in the display currency; 0 disables the check.
settings.thresholds.note: Stored with the persisted settings; alerts are evaluated in a later phase.
settings.error.loadFailed: Settings could not be read from the backend.
settings.error.saveValidation: One or more values were rejected; check the fields and retry.
settings.error.saveConflict: The settings changed elsewhere; showing the stored values. Review and save again.
settings.error.localeNotSaved: The language switched in this window but was not saved to the settings. Try saving it again from Settings.
desktop.heading: Desktop integration
desktop.note: Tray and notification support are detected on this machine, not assumed. Nothing is read or sent until you choose an action.
desktop.tray.label: System tray
desktop.tray.available: Available. Closing the window keeps QuotaVista in the tray; choose Quit to exit.
desktop.tray.unavailable: Unavailable. Closing the window exits QuotaVista instead of leaving a hidden collector.
desktop.notification.label: System notifications
desktop.notification.delivered: The operating system confirmed the notification.
desktop.notification.queued: Handed to the platform, which never reported back. The message is repeated here.
desktop.notification.explained: Delivery is unavailable, so the message stays here instead.
desktop.capabilities.error: Desktop capabilities could not be read.
desktop.notification.error: The test notification could not be sent.
